lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: What are you up to?
I see Arcana's message but don't answer because I'm in the middle of a game.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: What's going on? My message is showing up as read.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Ah, I get it.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: You're playing hard to get, aren't you?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: All right, fine. You better answer me in 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: If you make me wait any longer, this plan of yours is gonna backfire.
Sorry! I was doing something else.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Were you gaming?
How did you know?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: You told me before how you like to play video games.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Also, 9 times out of 10,

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: the reason men aren't punctual with their replies is because they're gaming.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: That's what I read on the internet.
What's the other 1 out of 10?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: They're with another woman.
I was gaming, promise.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Haha, you don't need to defend yourself.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: But,

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: what if I were to ask you

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: whether you thought video games or me were more important?
Hmm...

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I bet that type of question would put you in a tight spot.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: So I won't ask.
Did you message me because you're bored?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Not really because I'm bored,

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: but I had less work to do than usual.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I'm pretty much finished with everything,

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: but I can't leave work early.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Soooo I'm sitting here in the Forbidden Library, zoning out.
I can come over if you want.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: But if you came here, what would you do?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: There's not much to do here, and we can't go outside either.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: You'll just be bored.
Then we can be bored together.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: You're already

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: registered in the biometric lock

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: that leads inside.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: You should be able to come in no problem.
I'll bring lemon tea and some snacks.
After I've finished getting ready and am reaching for my phone, I get a message.
